render.stationsManifestPrelude:
# nokia9300rom (VMID 220) — the nokia9300 station's sibling on the ROM window-server track: the same
# launcher, rootfs shape and golden v3.1 (+ the resident SysState helper), EKA2L1 built from fork
# s80-rom-full and started with EKA2L1_ROM_WSERV=1, so the ROM's own ewsrv.exe paints the screen. HIDDEN.
render.bindingComment: ideal: a Nokia 9300 Communicator lying open — the 640x200 screen above the QWERTY keyboard, the four command buttons to the right of the screen

pointer.device: none — the Nokia 9300 has no pointing device and no touchscreen: Series 80 is driven by the four command buttons, the joystick and the keyboard. The x11test backend is present for KEYS only (SH_X11TEST_KEYS=1).

spa.eraLabel: 2005 · Series 80 v2 (Symbian OS 7.0s) · ROM window server

museum.lineage: Nokia Communicator (9000, 9110, 9210, then the 9300 and 9500 on Series 80 v2)
museum.arch: TI OMAP1510 (ARM925T @ 150 MHz), 64 MB RAM, 640x200 65,536-colour inner display, QWERTY keyboard, clamshell
eraSoftware: Documents and Sheet, the Communicator's word processor and spreadsheet
museum.periodBrowser: Opera 6.0 for Symbian OS, build 543 (the built-in Web application, ROM oprmodel.dll)
museum.blurb: A Nokia 9300 Communicator running its own firmware: closed it is a phone, opened it is a 640x200 landscape screen over a full QWERTY keyboard, with four command buttons beside the screen whose labels change with the application. Symbian OS 7.0s with the Series 80 v2 interface, firmware 5.22 (November 2005). Here the firmware's own window server (ewsrv.exe) draws every pixel of the screen.
museum.notes: Dark-launched COMPARISON sibling of nokia9300: identical container, launcher, keymap and golden v3.1 (plus C:\System\Programs\SysState.exe, the resident state publisher the ROM window server starts), but EKA2L1 is built from fork branch s80-rom-full and run with EKA2L1_ROM_WSERV=1 + EKA2L1_ROM_FBS=1: the ROM's own window server, font and bitmap server and Eikon run. See docs/guests/nokia9300rom.md.

emulator.version: Wnt/EKA2L1 fork, branch s80-rom-full @ 20ee52b11 (Z4 worker F): the full ROM stack = s80-rom-boot (A: the ROM's own ewsrv.exe behind EKA2L1_ROM_WSERV=1, controlled startup via the resident SysState helper, RTimer::Lock, FullName, ChangeLocale, VideoDriver/HAL) + s80-rom-input (B: ROM raw input, EKeyb, key/type socket verbs) + s80-rom-apps (D: the ROM window bridge behind ekactl list/focus/switch) + E's ROM fbserv.exe behind EKA2L1_ROM_FBS=1 + the HLE font-size fix, on s80-integration @ b1fec4a28.
emulator.driver: RAE-6 (Nokia 9300), epoc7, firmware 5.22 SYM.ROM + Z: tree + the four Series 80 UI fonts; EKA2L1_ROM_WSERV=1 EKA2L1_ROM_FBS=1; --run 0x101f8e4f (Desk) --kiosk --kiosk-home 0x101f8e4f --control-socket

network.note: Retronet web plane via nokia9300's NETNS CAGE with its own claims: x11-runtime.sh (NOKIA_NET=retronet, NOKIA_RN_IP=10.99.0.44) runs the shared rn-netns.sh with RN_STATION=nokia9300rom and starts the systemd-nspawn container inside netns rn-nokia9300rom (nsenter --net; nspawn's --network-namespace-path is refused under --private-users), whose only interface is the guest end of veth nokia9300romrn0/nokia9300romrng; the host end is enslaved to vmbr-rn (no uplink). Static 10.99.0.44 (reservation kept in RETRONET_DHCP_RESERVATIONS), MAC per the fleet scheme in gitignored local.env (RN_NOKIA9300ROM_MAC), no default route in the netns and no CAP_NET_ADMIN in the container, fail-closed NOKIA9300ROMRN-IN chain above RETRONET-IN. The netns resolv.conf (the gateway's wildcard DNS 10.99.0.2) is bound over the container's /etc/resolv.conf; config.yml hosts: stays empty and Opera needs no proxy. See docs/lab/retronet/WEB-STATION-nokia9300rom.md.

reset.mouse: N/A — the Nokia 9300 has no pointing device and no touchscreen; the exhibit publishes no pointer (stream.pointer.present=false).
reset.keyboard: ROM raw input (fork s80-rom-input, Z4 worker B): XTEST keys reach the ROM window server's own key tables (Nordic layout 6), per nokia9300's keymap and 0/0 pacing. Framebuffer proof in the D5 report.
reset.fixture: Desk as the ROM's own window server (ewsrv.exe) paints it under EKA2L1 s80-rom-full @ 20ee52b11 with EKA2L1_ROM_WSERV=1 + EKA2L1_ROM_FBS=1: date header, Personal / Office / Media / Tools, Clock, Nokia.com, command buttons and the ROM Eikon status pane, at 2x in a 1280x400 root. Golden = nokia9300's golden v3.1 + C:\System\Programs\SysState.exe (Z4 worker F's rebuild of tools/s80-sysstate at s80-rom-full 20ee52b11: state publisher + ROM window-bridge snapshots; sha256 6e8b2068…fac0). resetMode=relaunch, in-process via `ekactl quit`, as nokia9300.
